newsitem.title: USA: SPX Corp Q1 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: SPX Corp Q1 oper shr rises.

text.p: NOTE: Q1 1997 income from operations was $34.7 million or $2.39 a share. Q1 1997 income from operations includes a $31.2 million gain, or $2.14 per share, on the sale of the Sealed Power division and a $4.1 million charge, or $.28 per share, on legal fees to be incurred on pending litigation.

First quarter 1996 income from operations was $2.8 million or $.20 per share. First quarter 1996 income from operations includes $1.4 million, or $.11 per share, of restructuring charges related to combining five divisions.

Without the unusual items, first quarter 1997 income from operations would have been $7.6 million, or $.53 per share, and compares to first quarter 1996 income from operations of $4.2 million, or $.31 per share.

Net income for the first quarter of 1997 was $24.4 million, or $1.68 per share. Net income included an extraordinary charge of $10.3 million, or $.71 per share, for costs to purchase $126.7 million of the company's 11-3/4% Senior Subordinated Notes.
